title: Stage 0 Comprehensive Adversarial Assessment: Work Done So Far & Future Roadmap

findings.title: Cross-tab close race resurrected deleted win:<id> cache entries
findings.resolution: Added this.closed guard in SummaryWindow.commit()/minimize(skipCommit), close(fromSync) flag, skipTouch=true inside syncFromStorage(), and JSON diff check in shim.js.

findings.title: Inline \(...\) LaTeX regex truncated expressions containing inner parentheses
findings.resolution: Updated inline math regex to /\\\(([^\n]+?)\\\)/g across src/utils/userscript-helpers.ts and youtube-feed-summariser.user.js, plus unit test assertion.

findings.title: Fixed-interval backup flags could bypass prompt-end backup discipline
findings.resolution: scripts/sandbox-backup.mjs rejects --interval, --cron, and --watch with exit code 2 and verifies every archive via SHA-256 + tar -tzf.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 1 ask-ladder fault-injection E2E coverage and Stage 3 backup diffing harden failover bounds and supply integrity without introducing untrusted eval/HTML injection surfaces.

findings.title: _interactionCleanup accumulated stale closures on every drag and resize operation
findings.resolution: Refactored onHeaderDown and onResizeDown in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js to splice out completed cleanupDrag/cleanupResize callbacks inside onUp.

findings.title: Simulator floating window header overflow never activated due to adaptive flag typo
findings.resolution: Corrected adaptive.collapseHeaderActions to adaptive.useOverflowHeaderMenu in src/App.tsx line 2193 and verified in live Chromium.

findings.title: TTS toast state in simulator is shared globally across open windows
findings.resolution: Logged in roadmap Stage 1 (stage-1-ask-pipeline-resilience) for per-window scoped toast isolation; zero functional impact on single-speaker TTS flow.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 1 per-window toast scoping and Stage 2 mobile/keyboard stress tests directly target remaining multi-window edge cases while keeping BoundedMemoryCache and RAF cleanup strict.

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: MOCK_VIDEOS[1] summary template literal stripped backslash from \circ and interpreted \t as TAB
findings.resolution: Double-escaped $100^\\circ\\text{C}$ and $87^\\circ\\text{C}$ in src/App.tsx; visually confirmed '100°C' and '87°C' in live Chromium screenshot.

findings.title: Compact (<540px) window headers lacked guaranteed drag grip and TTS speed slider touched right border
findings.resolution: Added .yt-win-drag-grip (GripVertical) in .yt-win-header and wrapped .yt-tts-speed-wrap / .yt-tts-speed-btns with flex-wrap; visually verified side-by-side compact + medium windows in r1-multi-compact.png.

findings.title: Keyboard-only arrow resize on separator handles not yet implemented
findings.resolution: Scheduled in roadmap Stage 2 (stage-2-accessibility-keyboard-nav) alongside ARIA live-region announcements.

roadmapReview.notes: Roadmap Stages 1–3 logically sequence multi-window polish, keyboard/ARIA accessibility, and offline export bundling with unanimous consensus gates required at each boundary.
